# upgrade all packages to latest possible versions
flutter pub upgrade --major-versions --unlock-transitive --tighten

# run all code generation (including localization)
dart run build_runner build

# clean all generated files
dart run build_runner clean

# run all tests
flutter test --test-randomize-ordering-seed=random

# detect unused and missing translations
dart run slang analyze

# sort translations according to base locale
dart run slang normalize

# automatically update CFBundleLocalizations
dart run slang configure

# generate splash screen
dart run flutter_native_splash:create

# cleanup generated splash screen
dart run flutter_native_splash:remove

# install firebase
curl -sL https://firebase.tools | bash

# upgrade firebase
curl -sL https://firebase.tools | upgrade=true bash

# login to firebase (google account needs to be added to firebase sternburg bingo project)
firebase login

# activate flutterfire cli
dart pub global activate flutterfire_cli

# configure project
flutterfire configure

# install xcodeproj (needed for flutterfire configure)
sudo gem install xcodeproj -v 1.24.0
